needs.proposedSignature: `grant-keyword`, `pump.keywords`, `anthem.keywords`, `aura.keywords`, `equipment.keywords` and `self-keywords.keywords` accept `Keyword | { keyword: Keyword; n: Amount }` instead of bare `Keyword`, so a parameterised keyword can be granted with its number.
needs.semantics: Every keyword-granting slot in the format is `Keyword[]`, a bare name with no parameter. That silently drops the number of every keyword that has one — 'gains firebending 5 until end of turn' (Sozin's Comet), 'has trample and annihilator 2' (Eldrazi Conscription), 'gains trample, annihilator 2, and haste until end of turn' (Flayer of Loyalties, Hideous Taskmaster), 'has menace, deathtouch, annihilator 1' (Nazgûl Battle-Mace). Round-trip rule 1 then scores the line 0 for the missing number even when the rest of the grant is right, so the line cannot be claimed honestly.
needs.clause: Each creature you control gains firebending 5 until end of turn.

needs.proposedSignature: `ALT_COST_IDS` gains 'foretell' so a face can declare `altCosts: [{ id: 'foretell', label: 'foretell', cost: { mana: <foretell cost> }, from: 'exile' }]`; `COVER_LINE_RE.altCosts` gains /^foretell (\{.+\})$/ so a `covers` entry `{ by: 'altCosts' }` claims the printed line; a special action (during your turn, pay {2}, exile the card from hand face down) registered by the family; conditions `{ kind: 'foretold' }` and `{ kind: 'cast-from', zone: 'exile' }`; a trigger `{ on: 'foretell', who: 'you' | 'any' }`; and a KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS entry `foretell: 'during your turn, you may pay {2} and exile ~ from your hand face down. cast it on a later turn for {cost}'`.
needs.semantics: CR 702.143a-c. Foretell is an alternative cast from exile plus a hand→exile-face-down special action gated to your own turn. None of it exists: AltCost.id has no 'foretell' (only ALT_COST_FROM was widened to 'exile' for it), no covers shape matches 'Foretell {1}{U}', and the renderer has no rules text, so the printed line scores 0 and every foretell card is capped below the 0.55 gate (measured on Doomskar: schema/lint/sandbox all ok, roundTrip 0.00, gap keyword:foretell). Four of the batch's spells also branch on how they were cast ('If this spell was cast from exile', 'If this spell was foretold'), which needs the two conditions; Dream Devourer GRANTS foretell with a derived cost and triggers on 'whenever you foretell a card'.
needs.clause: Foretell {1}{W}{W} (During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.)
